additional_info.subject: 0444469 - ID0444469-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R5 170001827]Plug status changes CRM:00271000962
additional_info.body:
Hello Chloe,
This is a known issue with our SECC. I’m currently in discussions with R&D about it. They’ve announced that the next version of the Sicharge D, which will be available next month, will resolve this issue.
If the disconnection occurs frequently, I can offer to update the SECC’s Docker. However, this update is recommended only if the issue happens often.
Let me know if you’d prefer to proceed with the update now or wait for the new version.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen/ Best regards,Francois WINCKEL

o not change the subject of this email when replying to it.
